from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OperatingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """One operating cash flow figure from a company's filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name the filing belongs to")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date (e.g. 'March 31, 2024')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The net cash from operating activities amount; negative for outflows")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is 'current' or 'previous' period")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_cash_flows: list[OperatingCashFlow]
